stepAnswer: A histogram of $$10000$$ sample means from samples of size $$n=1000.$$
stepBody: Suppose we have a census of household incomes for the entire state of California. Which of the following histograms would most closely resemble a normal curve?
answerLatex: A histogram of $$10000$$ sample means from samples of size $$n=1000.$$
choices: A histogram of $$10000$$ sample means from samples of size $$n=1000.$$
A histogram of incomes from a SRS of $$n=10000$$ households.
A histogram of incomes from the entire census.
None of these would resemble a normal distribution.
